title: 3tchedFS source-derived typed filesystem contract
description: Plugin-owned current-source 3tchedFS contract: typed namespace, backing relationships, no reusable filesystem payload caches, bounded per-descriptor I/O, committed public state, workspace CAS, canonical method receipts and recovery. Exported documents and bindings derive from this authority. Each backend's sealed PluginSchema remains the authority for its arguments, results and capability admission. This revision is authored source, not tested or deployed proof.

file_attributes.statement: Directories0555,nlink2; public ordinary/live files0444; writable workspace and call files0600; symlinks0777. Writable nodes belong to assigned local caller UID, others to daemon UID; GID is daemon GID. Times remain epoch, block size4096. Root may assign a different local caller UID; other daemons may assign only their own UID. Backend identity/grants remain separately enforced.

cache_and_freshness.statement: Entry and attribute TTL are zero. Successful file opens use FOPEN_DIRECT_IO; fresh opens snapshot their exact declared source once. Namespace stores topology/locators only; no live_cache or latest-result/error cache remains.

cache_and_freshness.statement: An already-open file keeps its Node, UID, access, source bytes and workspace expected hash independently of later refresh. Directory handles keep their owned listing. Reopening reads new authoritative source; this is transient ownership, not derived-result reuse.

cache_and_freshness.statement: Startup/static traversal builds locators without SHM. Data discovery clears stale descendants and rebuilds only the addressed committed public plugin subtree; no schema/value/rendered-document or generation cache. Target catalog verification occurs before and after the canonical committed read. Existing handle getattr/readdir use owned descriptor/listing without refresh.

Direct SHM and mounted live factories initially retain static locators only. Explicit data enumeration refreshes only the selected plugin subtree; direct dynamic reads discover that same subtree before locating bytes. Scoped replacements retain unrelated locators, remove stale target descendants on failure, and propagate target errors. Mounted static enumeration consumes declared directory entry kinds and skips data recursion and all-plugin object/value reads. Workspace frozen enumeration remains separate. No value/schema/document or generation cache is introduced.

identity_and_admission.statement: HostSession carries public named-session selector; GuestKernel carries no selector and binds current native container using kernel peer evidence; Credential rereads SID1 and registers on the same D-Bus connection; Unbound cannot invoke. Mounted and typed factories require exact declared mode and canonical mount instance UUID; no cross-mode transport fallback occurs.

identity_and_admission.statement: Dispatch creates a canonical UUID before submission and calls PluginV1.CallWithOperationId through the same verified connection/admission. UUID is correlation only; receiver-derived actor/session and exact sealed capabilities select authority. Backend denial cannot be routed around; failed/unknown calls never automatically retry.

write_receipt_concurrency.statement: FUSE callbacks enqueue bounded jobs and return without waiting for backend round trips. Per-handle state owns one execution, up to32 reply waiters; repeated flush/fsync reuses terminal status and does not execute again. Release removes FH lookup, while an already-admitted worker retains charged buffers, slot and workspace guard until completion.

write_receipt_concurrency.statement: At most one local writer owns a workspace/plugin object guard. The store validates expected captured object hash under its existing filesystem writer lock; cross-process changes cause StageConflict/ESTALE without overwriting. Failed staging is terminal for that FD; successful staging updates expected hash, and future discovery rebuilds shape.

write_receipt_concurrency.statement: The cancellation-owned task atomically reserves permanent scoped operation ID in the existing durable Cozo runtime-document owner before audit/backend. Confirmed durable attempt and journal proof precede effect; durable terminal audit links exact attempt before journal status publishes. Completion requires validated declared result and successful authoritative publication. Cross-store or post-effect failure is unknown, never rolled back success.
write_receipt_concurrency.verification: implemented source; build, deployment and tests pending

write_receipt_concurrency.statement: get_receipt reads one receiver-derived actor/session/UUID journal key durably. Every reused ID is rejected before effects, including conflicting methods/visible arguments and after restart/audit retention. Recovery exposes status and attempt/terminal proofs only, never private domain data or raw argument/result digests. No caller may select journal namespace/key/principal. Generic cognitive-owner DB path aliases are rejected.

write_receipt_concurrency.statement: Both direct dispatch and mounted helper validate nested canonical envelope target, canonical operation UUID, ordered positive event IDs/hashes and exact declared result. Missing returns is unknown source contract and rejects before effects; explicit null schema validates null. Same-call FD carries receipt or bounded attributed error; no result/error nodes survive release.

source_errors.statement: Negative offsets and invalid values EINVAL; unknown FD or wrong access EBADF; foreign FD UID EACCES; inflight data I/O EAGAIN; already-terminal writes EINVAL; immutable writes/chmod/chown EROFS; CAS stale ESTALE; oversized EFBIG; allocation/budget ENOMEM; job/writer/waiter capacity EBUSY. Transport/outcome unknown EIO and missing result contract EPROTO. Typed bindings preserve semantic condition plus exact raw diagnostic/errno; unknown effect is never a retryable success.

source_refresh.statement: CLI strict or explicit schema-only capture and bounded invocation input remain. Mounted CLI/MCP delivery starts before ObjectStore resolution, derives declarations without reading object/state payloads, and reads addressed public state/calls solely through its assigned namespace. Existing lungs resources retain fresh canonical public-state/workspace reads with active catalog checks. MCP retains declarations and tool registry, never live state values.

Existing session-arrival/state-change events persist while holding the same audit chain write lock; known durability failure marks method_audit_uncertain. Method completed proofs require their own confirmed durable ordered attempt and terminal; no broader global cryptographic prefix theorem inferred.

steps: Startup builds pinned static locators and empty data directories without SHM reads. Live data discovery reads only the addressed plugin from fresh committed public state with active catalog checks. Open handles keep their admitted version; reopening rereads authoritative state.
Use canonical component encoding and exact pointer escaping; validate enumerated membership rather than inventing backend identifier grammars.
Preserve exact local UID/access mode, mount NoDev/NoSuid/NoExec/DefaultPermissions, caller identity and sealed grants; direct read routes grant no mutation capability.

Captured objects verify their content address; active catalog pins and declaration/public-policy equality govern live reads and operation admission. The sealed backend plugin remains schema authority.
Pin kernel mount identity/root descriptor, metadata/view and canonical instance UUID; require exact host/guest/credential/workspace mode and reject replacement.
Arguments match exact pinned MethodDecl; canonical bridge re-admits compiled sealed declaration and validates inputs. Absent output contract rejects before effect.
Same receiver-authenticated connection selects identity; UUID never selects principal or grants. Preserve canonical method-specific admission and backend-specific checks.

A local successful write only stages input. fsync/flush/release must produce canonical validated terminal receipt; backend or publication uncertainty remains unknown. Recover proof/status through declared get_receipt, never automatic replay or private result export.
Only writable frozen public workspace data can stage; validate complete candidate state and immutable base; backend mutation goes through CallFile.
CAS and workspace stage occur under one existing exclusive store lock; caller's expected object hash must still match.
Object write and atomic workspace manifest publication use temporary file sync, rename and parent sync. Store/SHM/journal boundaries are not represented as one cross-store transaction.

Refresh only addressed live data topology on lookup/open/getattr/opendir; startup and static traversal avoid SHM. Handle-bound getattr and readdir use admitted owned descriptors/listings without refresh. Workspace staging retains checked publication. Existing handles retain explicit bytes/listing until release.
Return explicit owned decoded BlobRef/ShmHandle snapshots with provenance. No reusable rendered data or live-value memoization, and no promise of POSIX shared-memory mapping/zero-copy layout.

gaps.finding: TypedFuse currently retains rendered live values in live_cache across opens. The owner explicitly disallows caches in this session. Source behavior is documented, not endorsed by the proposed memory policy.
gaps.owner_policy: no l1 cache. caches generall not allowed on this system
gaps.owner_policy_provenance: User steering in fs-schema-20261005; policy instruction, not a source-code fact.
gaps.source_change: Remove TypedFuse.live_cache and StateKey memoization. Each open should obtain an authorized committed snapshot through the canonical reader and decode it into a bounded transient handle buffer. Drop buffers on release; do not add per-mount, cross-mount or SHM result caches. Audit the existing one-second view metadata TTL against the same no-cache policy.
gaps.payoff: Conforms read behavior and memory ownership to the owner's no-cache policy.

gaps.finding: FUSE live reads stat/read a raw plugin JSON pathname without the existing projection transaction lock, publishing gate, pending-document/credential gates, or sealed public-state projection. Capture compares generations but its StateManifest decodes only generation and can substitute templates. A matching generation is not proof of a committed, identity-scoped state snapshot.
gaps.route_difference: An authoritative direct reader using the existing projection API can reject an incomplete publication which the current FUSE reader may expose. Direct-shm is deliberately unavailable in the generated bindings.
gaps.source_change: Use read_projection_snapshot_bounded_in (or an identity-scoped equivalent owned by the existing backend) in capture and live reads; apply the plugin-owned exposure policy with verified caller scope before projection. Return a typed unavailable/incomplete-publication result instead of silently substituting defaults when authority is required.
gaps.payoff: Makes direct and mounted reads agree on committed state and identity boundaries; prerequisite to safe direct-shm access.

gaps.finding: Workspace staging changes content-addressed local COW objects. A call authenticates an identity and executes a declared method through D-Bus/MutationEngine. These are different effects; a direct SHM/blob replacement cannot implement a plugin call.
gaps.route_difference: CallFile has only via-fuse; no direct mutation implementation is emitted. Workspace put does not apply backend state.
gaps.source_change: Keep mutations on the existing authenticated dispatch path. If a native typed transport is needed, expose the existing declaration, validation, identity, capability, audit and receipt contract through that owner rather than adding a store writer.
gaps.payoff: Preserves identity and audit semantics while allowing generated typed arguments and results.

gaps.finding: MutationEngine appends the attempt event and emits MethodCall before backend execution; durable audit persistence failure is logged. An event/hash alone does not prove effect completion. Caller cancellation does not cancel admitted backend work.
gaps.route_difference: A direct mutation implementation would have to preserve admission, attempt ordering, owned execution, state publication and terminal result semantics. No such implementation is claimed.
gaps.source_change: Add a linked, durable terminal outcome in the existing audit/receipt owner if completion-proof semantics are desired; preserve the attempt record. Define succeeded, failed and unknown outcomes plus retry rules. Do not reorder the existing attempt record and call it an equivalent change.
gaps.payoff: Lets callers distinguish attempted, completed and unknown effects and avoid duplicate mutations after disconnect.

gaps.finding: Plugin state and method args/results depend on the selected sealed catalog. The generic filesystem module uses an explicit recursive JSON sum type and the canonical runtime schema; it does not invent static Rust structs for every possible future plugin. Custom field validators are named but not executed by the standalone projection; OneOf accepts at least one reduced branch.
gaps.route_difference: Full per-plugin compile-time shapes are not generated by this generic binding. JSON is structured and decoded, not opaque bytes.
gaps.source_change: Specialize this generator against an explicitly pinned sealed PluginSchema catalog, using the existing schema authority for input/output definitions; carry the schema hash in generated method handles and reject a different catalog. Keep plugin custom validation in canonical dispatch.
gaps.payoff: Compile-time per-plugin fields and tighter return types without a second plugin schema authority.

gaps.finding: The namespace tree is built from captured object.value. Live file content changes at open, but newly added keys and array elements do not gain nodes in an existing view. Missing live pointers produce JSON null.
gaps.route_difference: Enumerating current SHM keys would differ from mounted readdir. Bindings enumerate pinned topology to retain existing semantics.
gaps.source_change: Add an explicit generation-pinned topology refresh owned by the filesystem, or define schema-backed map/array enumeration with a separate typed generation token. Update inode/cache invalidation at the same boundary.
gaps.payoff: Reliable typed enumeration of changing collections.

gaps.finding: ObjectStore stage_pointer holds the store-wide lock and publishes the workspace manifest atomically. FUSE then rebuilds its in-memory namespace. Direct store staging cannot refresh another running mount's namespace; concurrent open handles retain their original buffers.
gaps.route_difference: A direct WorkspaceField.put would leave the existing mounted topology stale; the generated workspace mutation uses via-fuse. A refresh failure after successful store publication returns EIO even though staging already occurred.
gaps.source_change: Provide an explicit store-generation notification and mount refresh acknowledgement through the filesystem owner; define conflict detection/versioned compare-and-swap for stale same-field writes if needed.
gaps.payoff: Safe direct workspace staging and clear post-write consistency.

gaps.finding: result and error are synthetic last-outcome buffers indexed only by plugin and method inside the mount. They have no stable SHM/blob locator and can be overwritten by another call. The invoking file handle retains its own terminal receipt.
gaps.route_difference: No direct outcome read exists. Bindings return call receipts from the same opened descriptor; Outcome.get is explicitly a last-method snapshot.
gaps.source_change: If durable retrieval is required, add a caller-scoped operation ID and immutable terminal receipt location owned by canonical dispatch. Do not use shared last-result files for correlation.
gaps.payoff: Reliable correlation and recovery after caller disconnect.

gaps.finding: Namespace links target absolute /plugins/... paths. Kernel following resolves them relative to the process root, which is not necessarily the mount root. The binding returns a semantic target without following the operating-system symlink.
gaps.route_difference: Semantic mount-local resolution is intentionally different from kernel absolute-path following.
gaps.source_change: Generate correct relative targets for operation/capability/dependency aliases, or formally constrain the mount to the process root and enforce that constraint.
gaps.payoff: Aliases work reliably at arbitrary mount locations.

gaps.finding: The filesystem consumes ordinary JSON/OPBLOB files under tmpfs paths with fs::read. ObjectStore JSON is compact content-addressed BLAKE3 data, distinct from the source OPBLOB01 binary schema container. No POSIX shared-memory segment name or fixed-layout plugin state record is exposed by this code.
gaps.route_difference: BlobRef and ShmHandle are immutable owned decoded values, not mapped borrowed Rust structs. No map method or shm_open implementation is emitted; segment size/alignment/lifetime cannot be invented from a /dev/shm prefix.
gaps.source_change: If measured decoding cost warrants it, define a versioned validated binary state ABI in the existing owner, with publication, mapping lifetime and exposure rules. For current JSON, a bounded mapped byte source still requires decoding and does not make T zero-copy.
gaps.payoff: Performance only after correctness and a measured need; prevents invalid typed mmap claims.

gaps.finding: The mounted helper validates outer plugin/method attribution, declaration metadata, successful fsync and existence of result. It does not validate nested engine success/event_id/event_hash or the domain result against MethodDecl.returns. The generic binding preserves that nested structured result without claiming a verified audit proof.
gaps.source_change: Define and validate the common engine receipt envelope in its existing owner, then validate the nested domain result against the pinned method return schema. Keep a distinct typed unknown-outcome error when a backend effect may already have occurred.
gaps.payoff: Typed terminal results and stronger completion evidence without retrying an ambiguous mutation.

gaps.finding: The new mounted binding pins a declared human session; guest kernel-authenticated, credential-backed and plain view mounts may not expose session_id and therefore do not have equivalent factory support. The FUSE loop blocks while the scoped D-Bus thread is joined; FUSE_INTERRUPT is unsupported. No watch, map, seal, capture, workspace commit/abort or snapshot control node is projected.
gaps.source_change: Add a verifiable public mount-mode/identity declaration without credentials for the other supported modes. Define cancellation semantics in the existing operation owner before adding asynchronous handles. Expose additional operations only through an explicitly authored canonical schema; ObjectStore CLI lifecycle methods are not filesystem node methods.
gaps.payoff: Broader factory coverage and responsive mounts with honest cancellation guarantees.
